description: Codex: Orks (11e) SPEEDIEST FREEKS (Kult of Speed, 1 CP; replaces the retired 10e kult_of_speed_speediest_freeks invulnerable-save scenario) through the real enemy_targets_unit_shooting fold-in of the defender's reactive StratagemDialog. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment is flipped to Kult of Speed and its stratagems reloaded; the Warbikers (SPEED FREEKS) are moved within Custodian Guard C's range. The Custodes player selects Custodian Guard C by clicking its token and declares its guardian spears (BS 2+) at the Warbikers (phase actions the shooting panel sends). The Ork player's dialog shows SPEEDIEST FREEKS with an enabled Use button; a real click spends 1 CP and marks the Warbikers. The Custodes resolve with the dock's Fast Roll / Complete Shooting buttons: an UNMODIFIED hit roll of 1-3 now fails, so the hit count equals the number of dice that rolled 4+ even though the guardian spears hit on 2+.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Warbikers move within Custodian Guard C's range, clear of every enemy
the panel auto-highlights a shooter on phase entry; picking another unit first makes the Custodian Guard C token click a real selection
hits = dice that rolled 4+ (unmodified 1-3 fail), and at least one 2-3 was rolled so the band mattered
r5:F10: the dice log's hit step names the SPEEDIEST FREEKS band (the 2s and 3s are coloured as fails)
WP-FIX1: no Sentinel Storm shoot-again prompt any more (a 10e Custodian Guard rule no codex datasheet has; WP-C7 retired it) - this step used to click its Decline button
